channel.title: The Ottawa Citizen - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ottawa Citizen (ottawacitizen.com)

item.title: Man and dog rescued from Rideau River in Barrhaven
item.description: Ottawa Fire Services' Ice Rescue Team was called to the scene just past 1:15 p.m. on Saturday.

item.title: Hundreds rally at U.S. Embassy in Ottawa to support military strike on Iran
item.description: The rally was held hours after Israel and the U.S. launched a major attack on Iran on Saturday.

item.title: What we're hearing going into the NHL's trade deadline next Friday
item.description: The new postseason salary cap, taking effect this spring, could affect movement going into the trade deadline.

item.title: How the Ottawa Charge lost to the Boston Fleet despite a dominant performance by Rebecca Leslie
item.description: A defeat in the shootout kept the Charge in fifth place in the standings, one point out of playoff position.

item.title: Ottawa Senators deliver knockout punch to Toronto Maple Leafs in Battle of Ontario
item.description: The victory to start a five-game road trip moved the Senators to within five points of the final wildcard spot in the Eastern Conference of the National Hockey League.

item.title: 'Not out of the woods,' but uOttawa president says budget nearly balanced
item.description: Ontario recently announced $6.4 billion more for colleges and universities. We talked to University of Ottawa president Marie-Eve Sylvestre about the bottom-line impact.

item.title: Former Senators coach D.J. Smith takes over Los Angeles Kings' top job
item.description: D.J. Smith, 48, was hired to be an associate coach with the Kings after being fired by the Senators midway through the 2023-24 campaign

item.title: Senators' Cozens, Batherson each score twice in dominant win over Maple Leafs
item.description: Dylan Cozens had three points, Drake Batherson scored his 20th goal of the season and Linus Ullmark gave Ottawa what it needed in goal.

item.title: Community group hosts clothing drive in honour of Rideau Street stabbing victim
item.description: The community support event was held in honour of Gilles Comtois, who was stabbed on Rideau Street near Colonel By Drive on Feb. 19

item.title: Pembroke man dead after being hit by vehicle on Highway 401
item.description: A vehicle had stopped in a live lane of Highway 401 due to a flat tire, and when a passenger got out of the vehicle he was struck by a second vehicle, police said
